To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1R dissections were performed by using the gametocida system and that 10 PCR-based marker were used to map the breakpoints of 1R disections.

the gametocidally induced chromosomal breakage of the 1RS chromosome of 'Burgas2' was cytologically analyzed and the PCR-based markers along 1RS were mapped with the breakpoints of 95 dissection lines.
we dissected the rye chromosome 1RS into 12 segments by using a gametocidal chromosome system and established 95 lines of common wheat with single 1R-derived segments.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the dissection of the 1r chromosome and the molecular characterization of the dissection lines, which will contribute to the development of new varieties of common wheat with resistance to rust diseases and to the improvement of common wheat.
the development of molecular markers that will facilitate the identification and use of 1R chromosome segments.
the development of new molecular cytogenetic tools for the analysis of chromosome rearrangements in common wheat.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 10 PCR markers were mapped along the 1RS chromosome with the breakpoints.
the 10 1R-derived markers were distributed in 12 regions along 1R chromosome and the 12 regions correspond to 12 breakpoints of the 95 1R dissections.
the PCR-based markers are not always in the order of their position on the 1R.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have dissected the 2.2-Mb-long 1R chromosome into 12 regions and that we have established 1R dissections lines that can be used to map DNA markers along the 12 regions.
we could separate the 1R chromosomes of 'Burgas2' into 12 regions and that we could map the 10 PCR markers along the 12 regions.
the 1R-derived segments were successfully mapped along the 1RS chromosome, and that the breakpoints of 1R-derived chromosome segments were successfully mapped on the 1R chromosomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we could dissect the 1R-derived chromosome in common wheat and establish a series of 1R dissections that will be useful for future studies on the 1R genome.
it is possible to dissect a rye chromosome into small fragments using the gametocidality system and to map DNA markers to the rye chromosome.
the dissection of the 1RS segment in common wheat is possible by using gametocidal chromosomes.
